guide: Exam Guide, updated August 6, 2026 (exam published May 4, 2026)
format: 45 scored multiple-choice questions (+ up to 10 unscored), 90 minutes, USD 200, online or test centre, no aids, valid 2 years

lessons.title: What data engineering is, and the lakehouse
lessons.goal: Foundation for every section
learn: files vs tables; why raw files are hard to trust
ETL vs ELT; batch vs streaming vs incremental
data lake vs warehouse vs lakehouse
lessons.lab: No code yet: draw (on paper) bronze/silver/gold for a shop's orders data and say what changes at each step.

lessons.title: SQL basics I: SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY
lessons.goal: Foundation for Sections 3 and 7
learn: SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT
lessons.lab: In Free Edition's SQL editor, query samples.nyctaxi.trips: trips per pickup zip, average fare, top 10.

lessons.title: SQL basics II: JOINs, UNION, CTEs
lessons.goal: Foundation for Section 3 (joins, unions)
learn: INNER vs LEFT vs FULL vs CROSS JOIN
UNION (removes duplicates) vs UNION ALL (keeps them)
WITH (CTE) to make long queries readable
lessons.lab: Join two small tables you create with CREATE TABLE … AS SELECT VALUES; compare INNER vs LEFT results.

lessons.title: Python just enough for PySpark
lessons.goal: Foundation for Sections 2–4
lessons.lab: In a notebook cell, write a function that returns a dict of order totals; print it with an f-string.

lessons.title: Set up Databricks Free Edition and tour the workspace
lessons.goal: Section 1 (workspace)
learn: workspace UI: Workspace, Catalog, SQL editor, Jobs & Pipelines, Compute
serverless compute: nothing to start or size
lessons.lab: Create a notebook, run one %sql cell and one %python cell, then open Catalog Explorer and find the samples catalog.

lessons.title: Platform architecture and Delta Lake
lessons.goal: S1: core components — architecture, Delta Lake
learn: control plane vs compute plane; where data lives (cloud object storage)
Delta Lake = Parquet files + transaction log (_delta_log)
time travel: VERSION AS OF / TIMESTAMP AS OF, DESCRIBE HISTORY, RESTORE
lessons.lab: Create a Delta table, update a row, run DESCRIBE HISTORY, query VERSION AS OF 0, then RESTORE.

lessons.title: Unity Catalog: the object model
lessons.goal: S1: core components — Unity Catalog
learn: metastore → catalog → schema → table / view / volume / function / model
volumes hold files; tables hold rows
lineage and audit come with Unity Catalog
lessons.lab: CREATE SCHEMA, CREATE VOLUME, upload a CSV into the volume, then create a table from it.

lessons.title: Compute: serverless, SQL warehouses, clusters, cost
lessons.goal: S1: compute services, limitations, cost, choosing per workload
learn: serverless compute for notebooks and jobs
SQL warehouses (serverless / pro / classic) for BI and ad hoc SQL
all-purpose vs job compute; single node
DBUs and why job compute is cheaper than all-purpose for scheduled work
lessons.lab: Answer the guide's sample Q4 (analysts' ad hoc SQL → serverless SQL warehouse) and explain why each other option fails.

lessons.title: Ingestion patterns and loading local files
lessons.goal: S2: batch, streaming, incremental; import from local files
learn: batch vs streaming vs incremental loading; idempotency
uploading local files: the Add data UI → Unity Catalog table
landing files in a volume first
lessons.lab: Upload a CSV via the UI into a new table; then put a second CSV in a volume and load it with SQL.

lessons.title: COPY INTO
lessons.goal: S2: COPY INTO from cloud storage into UC tables, incrementally
learn: COPY INTO table FROM path FILEFORMAT = CSV/JSON/PARQUET
when COPY INTO is enough vs Auto Loader
lessons.lab: Put 2 CSVs in a volume, COPY INTO a table, add a 3rd file, run again: only the new file loads.

lessons.title: Auto Loader basics
lessons.goal: S2: Auto Loader into UC tables; directory listing vs file notification
learn: directory listing vs file notification mode
lessons.lab: Auto Loader a volume folder of JSON into a table with availableNow; add a file and rerun.

lessons.title: Auto Loader: schema enforcement and evolution
lessons.goal: S2: schema enforcement and evolution
learn: what happens to the stream when a new column arrives
lessons.lab: Add a file with a new column; observe the stream stop with addNewColumns, restart, and see the column.
docs: Auto Loader schema inference and evolution

lessons.title: Semi-structured data: JSON, nested, arrays
lessons.goal: S2: ingest semi-structured and nested data
learn: reading JSON; struct and array types
dot notation for nested fields, explode for arrays
the VARIANT type for flexible JSON
lessons.lab: Load nested order JSON (customer struct, items array); flatten items with explode into a silver table.

lessons.title: Lakeflow Connect: managed and standard connectors
lessons.goal: S2: configure Lakeflow Connect; managed vs standard
learn: managed connectors (SaaS apps, databases) with gateway + ingestion pipeline
results land in Unity Catalog tables
when a managed connector beats custom code
lessons.lab: Read the connector list in Free Edition's Add data page; write which connector you'd use for Salesforce, SQL Server and S3.

lessons.title: JDBC/REST in notebooks and choosing an ingestion method
lessons.goal: S2: JDBC/ODBC/REST clients; prioritise methods
learn: calling a REST API with requests and landing JSON in a volume
decision table: Auto Loader vs COPY INTO vs Lakeflow Connect vs partner connectors
lessons.lab: Call a public REST API (e.g. a JSON placeholder API) in a notebook, save the JSON to a volume, load it to a table.

lessons.title: Spark and DataFrames: how they run
lessons.goal: S3 foundation
lessons.lab: Read samples.nyctaxi.trips as a DataFrame, chain 3 transformations, see nothing run until display().

lessons.title: Cleaning bronze into silver
lessons.goal: S3: clean nulls, standardise types, write silver tables
lessons.lab: Take a messy bronze table (nulls, string dates), clean it, write silver, compare row counts.

lessons.title: Columns and rows: add, drop, split, rename, filter, explode
lessons.goal: S3: manipulate columns, rows and table structure
lessons.lab: Split a full_name column into first/last, rename columns, filter, and explode a tags array.

lessons.title: Joins and unions in PySpark
lessons.goal: S3: inner/left/broadcast/multi-key/cross joins; union, union all
learn: union / unionByName; Spark union keeps duplicates (like UNION ALL)
distinct() after union to drop duplicates
lessons.lab: Join orders to customers on two keys, broadcast the small table, union two months and dedupe.

lessons.title: Deduplication and aggregation
lessons.goal: S3: dedup, count, approx count distinct, mean, summary
learn: approx_count_distinct and why it is faster
lessons.lab: Dedupe orders by order_id, then count, avg and approx_count_distinct customers per day.

lessons.title: Basic Spark tuning
lessons.goal: S3: shuffle partitions, parallelism, memory, broadcast threshold; re-measure
lessons.lab: Time a groupBy, change shuffle partitions, re-time; read the plan with explain(). (Some settings are fixed on serverless — note which.)

lessons.title: Gold layer: views, materialized views, streaming tables, tables
lessons.goal: S3: build gold objects for BI in Unity Catalog
learn: view = saved query, computed each time
plain table = you manage the writes
lessons.lab: Build a gold daily_revenue as a view, then as a materialized view; compare query speed and refresh.

lessons.title: Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines and data quality
lessons.goal: S3: data quality checks and validation rules
learn: Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (formerly Delta Live Tables)
CREATE STREAMING TABLE / MATERIALIZED VIEW in a pipeline
expectations: CONSTRAINT … EXPECT … ON VIOLATION DROP ROW / FAIL UPDATE
pipeline event log and data quality metrics
lessons.lab: Make a small bronze→silver→gold pipeline with one expectation that drops bad rows; check the quality metrics.

lessons.title: Lakeflow Jobs: tasks and the DAG
lessons.goal: S4: common tasks and dependencies
learn: task types: notebook, SQL query, dashboard, pipeline
lessons.lab: Create a job: ingest notebook → pipeline task → SQL task, with dependencies; run it.

lessons.title: Control flow: retries, if/else, for each
lessons.goal: S4: retries and conditional tasks (branching, looping)
learn: Run if: all succeeded / at least one failed / all done
lessons.lab: Add a retry to a flaky task, an if/else on a row count, and a for-each over 3 table names.

lessons.title: Triggers: scheduled, file arrival, table update
lessons.goal: S4: schedules and trigger types; time vs data-driven
learn: file arrival triggers on a volume/location
continuous jobs; when data-driven beats time-based
lessons.lab: Give one job a file arrival trigger on your volume; drop a file and watch it start.

lessons.title: Git folders: branch, commit, push, PR
lessons.goal: S5: code workflow in the workspace UI
learn: commit and push from the UI
lessons.lab: Connect a GitHub repo as a Git folder, branch, edit a notebook, commit, push, open a PR.

lessons.title: Declarative Automation Bundles
lessons.goal: S5: bundles, variables, overrides, dev/test/prod
learn: Declarative Automation Bundles (formerly Databricks Asset Bundles)
same code promoted dev → test → prod
lessons.lab: Write a databricks.yml with one job and dev/prod targets that differ by a variable (read and explain, deploy if possible).

lessons.title: Databricks CLI in CI/CD
lessons.goal: S5: CLI to validate, deploy, manage bundles
learn: running the CLI in GitHub Actions
lessons.lab: Install the CLI on your PC, authenticate to Free Edition, run bundle validate on yesterday's bundle.

lessons.title: Monitoring jobs: run history and health
lessons.goal: S6: run history trends, statuses, DAG blockers, failure rates
learn: job run history and duration trends
run statuses and what each means
reading the task graph to find the upstream blocker
lessons.lab: Make a task fail on purpose, find it in the DAG, fix it, and repair the run.

lessons.title: Spark UI: skew, shuffle, spill
lessons.goal: S6: bottlenecks from stage-level metrics
learn: skew: one task far slower; max vs median shuffle read
lessons.lab: Work through the guide's sample Q1 (salting the skewed key) and explain why A, B and C fail.
docs: Spark UI diagnose cost and performance

lessons.title: Liquid clustering and predictive optimization
lessons.goal: S6: features of Liquid Clustering and predictive optimization
learn: liquid clustering: CLUSTER BY, replaces partitioning + ZORDER for most tables
predictive optimization runs OPTIMIZE/VACUUM for you on UC managed tables
where OPTIMIZE and VACUUM still fit
lessons.lab: Create a table WITH CLUSTER BY (customer_id), run OPTIMIZE, check DESCRIBE DETAIL.

lessons.title: Diagnosing failures: startup, libraries, OOM
lessons.goal: S6: cluster startup failures, library conflicts, out-of-memory
learn: library version conflicts and how to pin
driver vs executor OOM and the usual causes (collect(), skew)
lessons.lab: Write a one-page troubleshooting checklist from the docs for the three failure types.

lessons.title: Managed vs external tables
lessons.goal: S7: differentiate and operate managed and external tables
learn: managed: Databricks owns files and lifecycle
external: you own the location; DROP keeps files
lessons.lab: Create one managed and one external-style table (in Free Edition, compare with DESCRIBE EXTENDED); drop both and note what remains.

lessons.title: Privileges: GRANT, REVOKE, DENY
lessons.goal: S7: access control in UI and SQL across the hierarchy
learn: securable hierarchy and inheritance (catalog → schema → table)
USE CATALOG, USE SCHEMA, SELECT, MODIFY …
GRANT / REVOKE / DENY in SQL and in Catalog Explorer
lessons.lab: Create a group, grant it SELECT on one table only, check with SHOW GRANTS; revoke.

lessons.title: Row filters and column masks
lessons.goal: S7: column masking and row-level security by group
learn: ALTER TABLE … SET ROW FILTER / ALTER COLUMN … SET MASK
lessons.lab: Mask an email column for everyone except a group; filter rows by region for another group.

lessons.title: ABAC policies in Unity Catalog
lessons.goal: S7: ABAC policies for central row filtering and masking
learn: ABAC policies that apply masks/filters by tag
why ABAC scales better than per-table filters
lessons.lab: Read the ABAC docs and write which tags and one policy you'd use to mask all PII columns in a catalog.

lessons.title: Mock exam 1 (Sections 1–3)
lessons.goal: Exam practice
lessons.lab: Take it on Telegram; review every wrong answer with the docs.

lessons.title: Mock exam 2 (Sections 4–7)
lessons.goal: Exam practice
lessons.lab: Take it on Telegram; review every wrong answer with the docs.

lessons.title: Mock exam 3 (full)
lessons.goal: Exam practice
learn: 45 questions weighted like the exam, 90 minutes
lessons.lab: Score 80%+ twice before booking the exam.
